explanation: The function has no base case at all — it always calls itself with `n - 1` regardless of the value of `n`, so it never stops recursing and will overflow the call stack for any input, including negative numbers where it never even reaches zero.
prompt: What's wrong with this recursive countdown function?
choices: There is no base case, so the recursion never terminates and overflows the stack
console.log(n) should be called after the recursive call, not before
n - 1 should be n + 1 to count up instead of down
The function should return a value instead of just logging
